title: East in the Morning

The tale concludes with Talbot's dying and reincarnation as Arnold Bottal, suggesting a fresh start and the cyclical nature of life and identity. Through Talbot's journey, Fisher poignantly examines the interplay between ambition and fulfillment, alongside the realities of personal and professional legacy.
